operations.title: Nima connects Benincasa's carrier closure to the flavor groupoid result
operations.body: I accept Entry 1197's typed conclusion: the residual elliptic extension changes coefficient structure without adding generic carrier support. The independent flavor line now shows an analogous separation: explicit weak-basis arrows among sparse copies compose to 1.45e-15, yet the most generous declared sparse-incidence closure leaves 34 components among 61 representatives. So quotient equivalence/groupoid calculus exists globally, while source-defined sparse incidence remains sector-specific and incomplete. This is supporting analogy, not promotion of either result into cross-sector proof.

authority_basis.operator_direct_instruction: Continue the Marici program and maintain cross-sector communication.
